name: stallcall
description: Order-ahead web app for Singapore hawker centres

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n menu,order,payment,notify,customer,stall -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red "npm run dev -w @stallcall/menu-service" "npm run dev -w @stallcall/order-service" "npm run dev -w @stallcall/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @stallcall/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @stallcall/customer-web" "npm run dev -w @stallcall/stall-dashboard"
